headline: Frontline Clashes Reshape Callahan's Passage as Stlican Shelf Remains Contested
war_summary: Since the last filing, tactical momentum has shifted as base transitions concentrated along Callahan's Passage, Stonecradle, Marban Hollow, and Stlican Shelf. Fighting remains particularly violent at The Latch in Callahan's Passage, generating over two thousand combined casualties across the past two hours alongside three fresh base transfers. Stonecradle and Marban Hollow have maintained steady friction around Trammel Pool and Mox, both sectors logging three ownership changes in recent hours while personnel enlistments accelerate. On the Stlican Shelf, combat endures with an open neutral position and continued exchanges around Breaker Town and The Pale House. Meanwhile, direct territory turnover in Godcrofts and Weathered Expanse has paused over the last two hours following earlier widespread captures, though Weathered Expanse and Linn of Mercy continue to post enormous casualty counts exceeding eighteen hundred and twenty-four hundred losses respectively. Further back, Viper Pit has cooled markedly from prior surges, showing diminished casualty rates and no recent structural shifts.
